pipeline.title: ARPA-H unveils Surpass program to accelerate and expand clinical trials
pipeline.summary: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services announced the launching of a new program aimed to remove barriers that slow clinical development and transform how clinical trials are designed and conducted.

pipeline.title: Cerevance rescues its Parkinson's drug with phase 3 win
pipeline.summary: Cerevance's oral non-dopaminergic therapy has redeemed itself by improving both motor and non-motor symptoms in a phase 3 Parkinson's disease study.

pipeline.title: Atsena’s Lighthouse gene therapy readout illuminates eye disease efficacy
pipeline.summary: Atsena Therapeutics has reported evidence of efficacy in a clinical trial of an eye disease gene therapy, encouraging the biotech to forge ahead with a study that could support a filing for approval in 2028.

pipeline.title: A Takeda spinout builds case for its Parkinson’s drug
pipeline.summary: Cerevance plans to meet with the FDA to determine next steps for a new kind of medicine known as solengepras, now that it has Phase 3 data in hand.

pipeline.title: MimiVax’s cancer vaccine fails phase 2 glioblastoma study, but CEO still sees data as ‘inspiring’
pipeline.summary: MimiVax has reports a phase 2b miss in newly diagnosed glioblastoma patients, but remains positive about a significant survival benefit in a subset of patients 65 years and under.

pipeline.title: ArriVent’s phase 3 lung cancer trial flops, sinking stock
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 lung cancer study of ArriVent BioPharma’s EGFR inhibitor has missed its primary endpoint, sending the biotech’s stock down 57% in early trading on the Nasdaq.

pipeline.title: Abbott nabs FDA approval for new CardioMEMS HF System that allows heart readings to be seen at home
pipeline.summary: Abbott has been given U.S. clearance for new updates to its CardioMEMS HF System that allow for patient-facing capabilities through its CardioGuide HF App.

pipeline.title: [Podcast] (Season 2) The Progress Profile: Alzheimer’s Research in Focus
pipeline.summary: This podcast explores how leading Alzheimer’s experts are working to bridge the gap between clinical trial design and frontline care.

pipeline.title: The top biopharma conferences in 2027
pipeline.summary: Medical meetings often feature important clinical trial results, making them barometers of biotech and pharma companies’ research progress. Here’s a list of conferences to watch for in 2027.

pipeline.title: Vaxcyte’s stock jumps as pneumococcal vaccine holds its own against Pfizer's, Merck’s shots
pipeline.summary: Vaxcyte has seen its stock jump after the biotech’s 31-valent pneumococcal vaccine candidate went head-to-head with Pfizer’s Prevnar 20 and Merck & Co.’s Capvaxive in a phase 3 contest.

pipeline.title: With FDA approval, Lilly’s BTK drug Jaypirca enters first-line CLL
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly’s Jaypirca, the first noncovalent BTK inhibitor, has won FDA approval for the first-line treatment of chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma, a market now led by BeOne’s Brukinsa.

pipeline.title: Proposed nuclear safety rules threaten to stall Novartis’ Pluvicto expansion
pipeline.summary: Novartis’ flagship radioligand therapy Pluvicto entered a rapid growth phase recently, driven by FDA approvals in earlier-stage prostate cancer and broader uptake in community settings. But a regulatory overhaul proposed by federal nuclear authorities now threatens to derail that

pipeline.title: Caribou to halt CAR-T work, lay off staff amid ‘challenging’ funding climate
pipeline.summary: Despite having an allogeneic cell therapy prospect that’s ready for late-stage testing in lymphoma, Caribou couldn’t secure funding to support the effort and will now pursue “strategic alternatives” instead.

pipeline.title: Halozyme prevails in patent fight with Merck; Enliven readies anticipated leukemia trial
pipeline.summary: A Dutch court barred Merck from selling subcutaneous Keytruda in several European countries. Elsewhere, an Insmed executive ended a seven-year run and two startups secured venture cash.

pipeline.title: Halozyme stymies subcutaneous Keytruda launch in select European countries as Merck vows to fight patent claims
pipeline.summary: After facing a setback in Germany late last year, Merck & Co.’s European marketing plans for its below-the-skin Keytruda SC are growing more complicated.

pipeline.title: TCGX launches $600M fund to bankroll Asian biotechs
pipeline.summary: Investment firm TCGX is expanding in Asia, raising $600 million to funnel into biotechs emerging from a burgeoning drug discovery hotspot.

pipeline.title: New API Innovation Center index spotlights supply chain stress points
pipeline.summary: The National Fragility Index, launched by the API Innovation Center, warned that more than 550 million prescriptions filled in the U.S. in 2023 were categorized as being highly or severely vulnerable to supply chain interruptions.

pipeline.title: Catalent wins access to Iro and launches next-gen development platform
pipeline.summary: Catalent will gain access to Ori's Iro platform, a proprietary automated cell and gene therapy manufacturing system that speeds up development and reduces costs.

pipeline.title: Matchpoint nets $150M series B to take covalent med into clinic
pipeline.summary: Matchpoint Therapeutics has aced its series B round, serving up $150 million to advance the Sanofi-backed biotech’s pipeline of precision covalent medicines.

pipeline.title: Stryker strikes up a new CEO in Spencer Stiles as Kevin Lobo moves upstairs
pipeline.summary: Stryker veteran Spencer Stiles will take up the chief executive role as its former CEO Kevin Lobo will move into the boardroom.

pipeline.title: CAR-T biotech Caribou makes ‘heartbreaking’ call to shrink headcount, halt pipeline
pipeline.summary: The Bay Area biotech is discontinuing all clinical development activities and implementing a "substantial reduction in workforce."

pipeline.title: Noom puts a spooky voice to the haunting threat of weight regain for GLP-1 users in new spot
pipeline.summary: Noom's horror movie-esque new ad showcases the haunting threat of weight regain on GLP-1s, which the Noom app can help fend off.

pipeline.title: How drugmakers are tapping into the GLP-1 frenzy's unprecedented 'consumer overlay'
